name: codex-text-control
description: Read a single continuous Markdown body as a reply, edit in place, and save a confirmed revision.

interface.shortDescription: Read a reply, click to edit, then save or cancel in place.
interface.longDescription: A quiet inline reply with formatted paragraphs, lists, tables and code. Click the text to edit in place; Save confirms an immutable revision for subsequent conversation turns. Recoverable drafts and conflict protection stay behind the scenes. This component does not replace native chat messages.
defaultPrompt: Open the context canvas and edit the current response
